column1: # Expected verdicts for verify-dream-journal.py on the journals in this directory.
# Consumer: verify-dream-journal.py --selftest, which runs every row in process and four rows (valid,
# signal, missing-file, deep-nesting) also as a subprocess (the CLI dream-write.py's run_validator
# uses); renaming or removing one of those four rows fails the selftest. Each <case>.out holds the exact expected
# stdout (LF line endings, one line per output line); the selftest compares it byte for byte.
# Expected outputs follow the Python verdict (the .sh twin's embedded Python); where the .ps1 twin
# differs (duplicate keys, case-only keys, one-element arrays, ISO timestamps, lenient JSON, invalid
# UTF-8) the row is still the Python verdict.
#   case    name; the expected stdout is <case>.out
#   input   journal file in this directory, or - for a path that does not exist
#   exit    expected exit code (0 = no FAIL, 1 = at least one FAIL or an unreadable file)
